data.exact_reserve_text: The claims incurred, as stated within the financial statements of GBP 7.2m (2014: GBP 5.5m) includes a deterioration of GBP 2.2m on 2013 & Prior years and a marginal movement on the other years of account (2014: GBP 0.3m deterioration) in relation to claims incurred at the prior year end principally due to the adverse developments of legacy European creditor business.

prior_year_events.event_name: Legacy European creditor business adverse development
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on legacy European creditor business led to reserve strengthening (deterioration), driven by lengthening of reporting timing and case reserve uncertainty.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 14.697m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a small net prior-year release of approximately GBP 0.47m, but management highlighted adverse development primarily on legacy European creditor (long-tailed accident & sickness) business - described as a deterioration of c. GBP 2.2m on 2013 & prior years - driven by lengthening of reporting timing and consequent reserve strengthening. Movements were therefore mixed: adverse development on legacy creditor and group business partially offset by favourable development elsewhere.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 2.2m on 2013 & Prior years
adverse developments of legacy European creditor business
lengthening of reporting timing by claimants
significant reserve strengthening on the legacy European creditor business
worse than expected development primarily on legacy European creditor and Group business
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 18). The managing agent's narrative refers to a deterioration of GBP 2.2m on 2013 & prior years (described in the context of 'claims incurred') which appears to pertain primarily to legacy European creditor business; however that narrative line sits within a discussion of claims incurred (P&L) and is not a clear tabled gross PY movement. The movement computed from the triangle is a small net release (~GBP 0.47m) while the narrative highlights a material adverse item on legacy creditor reserves - this indicates mixed movements across portfolios. The reconciliation between the triangle, the 'movement in provision' reconciliation rows and narrative statements is ambiguous; the triangle was used as the primary quantitative source per extraction rules.
